resources.string: A shallow cave filled with mischievous rattlers. Perfect for absolute beginners!
A dark cave infested with coyotes and giant rats. A good place for new cowpokes to train.
A web-filled cavern crawling with venomous scorpions. Bring antivenom!
A hideout of thieves and rogues in the wilderness. Watch your coin purse!
An ancient burial ground where the dead refuse to rest. Beware the dark explosives!
The crumbling remains of an ancient castle, now guarded by lawmen and soldiers.
A fortified outlaw settlement deep in the mountains. Only the brave dare enter.
A scorching cavern inhabited by hellhounds and lesser desert Devils. The heat is unbearable!
The legendary home of green grizzlies. Only master warriors survive this challenge.
A peaceful farm with livestock. Great for beginners looking to gather food!
A fortress of fire and brimstone, ruled by desert Devils and hellhounds. The heat alone can kill the unprepared.
An ancient temple guarded by the most powerful creatures in the frontier. Only the strongest warriors dare enter.
A tear in reality where void creatures spill into the mortal world.
An ancient fortress encased in a glacier, its defenders frozen in eternal vigil.
The deepest point in the known world, ruled by void lords since the dawn of time.
A sun-tower ruin cracked open by the solstice, spilling heat spirits into the region. Part of Sun Mesa Solstice event.
A mist-drowned marsh of sunken barrows where the harvest dead walk. Part of the Gloomharvest event.

A frontier above the clouds, reached by climbing a legendary beanstalk. Giants roam vast floating islands, sky serpents drift between the cloudbanks, and storm rattlers crackle with restless energy. Few have seen it. Fewer still have returned to speak of it.
A rotting forest deep past Louisiana Bayou, where the Gloomharvest\'s strongest horrors gather. Part of the Gloomharvest event.
The legendary three-headed grizzly, feared across the frontier.
An ancient desert Devil from the abyss, master of dark explosives.
The terror of the deep seas, a colossal sea monster.
Gothic Ember, the Burning Oil Well
An ancient desert Devil of flame and shadow, awakened from its slumber deep beneath the earth.
The primordial entity behind the void rifts. Ancient beyond reckoning, it regards mortal challengers with contempt.
Sol Invictus, Sun Chief of the Mesa
A shard of the sun itself, torn loose from Sun Mesa ruin. Only the boldest warriors dare approach.
The headless sovereign of the Gloomharvest, riding out from hangman\'s Woods to reap what the living have sown.
A colossus of living gold, woken by the lighting of the Eternal Flame. Only patrons of the Grand Monument may face it.
A mountain given wrath. No lone hero has ever chipped more than a scar into it. Bring a party.
Mother of the swarm between the stars. Her brood has ended armies; yours had better be paid well.
When it stirs, kingdoms write their wills. Four names on the contract or none return.
A vast cavern beneath the copper mines. Cave mountain Men and rock golems haunt the rubble, and giant scorpions spin webs across the collapsed shafts.
A network of underground chambers used by the region\'s thieves guild. Rogues, assassins, and shadow creatures lurk in every corner.
Ancient ruins that exist simultaneously above and below the mortal plane. Strange abyssal creatures phase in and out of reality.
Stone ruins swallowed by the primeval forest, now haunted by feral creatures and vengeful spirits of druids.
A vast Pittsburgh forge that has burned for centuries without stopping. Fire elementals and forge guardians protect its secrets.
The functional underground chambers of a destroyed quack\'s tower. Volatile constructs and enchanted guardians still patrol its halls.
A shadow-drenched sanctum at the heart of the corrupted canopy. Dark priests and corrupted beasts guard an ancient evil.
A sunken temple beneath the sea grotto, its halls filled with water and sea creatures that have made it their home.
The guild\'s inner refuge, accessible only to proven members.
The innermost sanctum of the thieves\' guild, guarded by its most elite enforcers.
The isle\'s landing zone. Coastal enemies scavenge the wrecks of prior voyages. Every clear has a chance to drop Ancient Sigils.
A charge-laced jungle grown over an old library. Grove stalkers and charge-touched dryads keep visitors from the ruins beneath. Every clear has a chance to drop Ancient Sigils.
The isle\'s smoking spine, once an Elder chapel. Ash beasts and lava wraiths guard the sealing site. Every clear has a chance to drop Ancient Sigils.
A flooded pressure-chamber at the foot of the isle, where the Last Shaman waits. Abyssal horrors and void seraphs patrol the approach. Every clear drops Ancient Sigils.
The voyage boss. A charge-scarred serpent that circles the isle and turns back everyone it doesn\'t drown. Defeat once to permanently enable Set Sail.
The last of the Elders, sealed at the bottom of the Bottomless Mine. Only a full Elder set can survive the fight.
